neighbours.label: The split-off adjective ending -ative, -atory or -ionate (prepar-ative, explor-atory, dispass-ionate); plain adjectives stay quiet
fire: The chemists ran a preparative column overnight.
Schools need an integrative approach to reading.
This was an exploratory study with ten patients.
Early facilitatory effects were seen in the cortex.
She gave a dispassionate account of the war.
Integrative medicine is popular in some clinics.
Preparative methods are slow but precise.
Historians need a dispassionate view of the past.
quiet: The chemists ran a long column overnight.
Schools need a better approach to reading.
This was a small study with ten patients.
Early strong effects were seen in the cortex.
She gave a brief account of the war.
Herbal medicine is popular in some clinics.
Older methods are slow but precise.
Historians need a clear view of the past.

notes: Card: 'ative' x5, 'atory' x5, 'ativ' x3, 'ionate' x2, 'ant', 'stantial', German 'iven'. The - pole has 'able', 'iz', 'izable'. Probe: 'ionate' 0.97, 'ative' 0.84, 'atory' 0.35-0.69; whole-token comparative 0.42, so the meaning-bearing form fires too; plain alternatives 0.02. Tokenizer checked.
